Package com.github.jpmsilva.jsystemd

Interface StatusProvider

All Known Implementing Classes:
ActuatorHealthStatusProvider, ApplicationContextStatusProvider, ApplicationRunStatusProvider, AvailabilityStatusProvider, BufferPoolStatusProvider, CgroupMemoryStatusProvider, ClassLoaderStatusProvider, CpuStatusProvider, ExecutorStatusProvider, FileDescriptorStatusProvider, GarbageCollectionStatusProvider, HeapStatusProvider, HikariStatusProvider, JettyStatusProvider, LiquibaseStatusProvider, NettyStatusProvider, NonHeapStatusProvider, OldGenerationStatusProvider, PhaseStatusProvider, ShutdownStatusProvider, TaskExecutorStatusProvider, ThreadStatusProvider, TomcatStatusProvider
public interface StatusProvider
Interface that represents any object that can contribute with status information regarding the running process to the service supervisor.

Status providers can be registered through Systemd.addStatusProviders(StatusProvider...)

Status providers only report the status: they must not drive the lifecycle of the application with Systemd.ready(), Systemd.stopping() or Systemd.close(), as they are called from the periodic status updates, which Systemd.close() waits for.
